title.en: HOW IT EARNS CASH | BUSINESS CHAIN

en: 1 Contract | Multi-year AI/cloud capacity deals: RPO $638B at FY26, $664B at Aug 31.
2 Build | FY26 capex $55.7B (82.6% of revenue) plus $288B of leases not yet begun.
3 Run | Q1 FY27 OCI revenue +121% to $7.39B; cloud apps +9.9% to $4.22B.
4 Defend | License support (~$24.5B, 36% of FY26) is the cash engine.
5 Collect | FY26 OCF $32.0B - capex $55.7B = FCF -$23.7B → debt, equity, prepayments.
zh: 1 签约 | 多年期 AI/云算力合同：FY26 末 RPO $638B，8月31日 $664B。
2 建设 | FY26 资本开支 $557 亿（占营收 82.6%），另有 $2,880 亿尚未起租的租约。
4 守住 | 许可证支持收入（约 $245 亿，占 FY26 36%）是现金引擎。
5 回款 | FY26 OCF $32.0B - 资本开支 $55.7B = FCF -$23.7B → 靠举债、增发、预付款补足。

watch.en: Watch: OCI delivery on time, capex vs OCF, and customer prepayments.
watch.zh: 关注：OCI 能否按时交付、资本开支与 OCF 的缺口、客户预付款。

text.en: RPO $638B at FY26 vs $138B a year earlier; ~13% to be recognised within 12 months.
text.zh: FY26 末 RPO $638B（上年 $138B）；约 13% 将在 12 个月内确认收入。

text.en: FY26 op. margin 30.6%; gross margin ~66% vs ~80% in FY17 as infrastructure costs rise.
text.zh: FY26 营业利润率 30.6%；随着基础设施成本上升，毛利率由 FY17 约 80% 降至约 66%。

text.en: FY26 OCF $32.0B - capex $55.7B = FCF -$23.7B; TTM gap -$28.7B; prepayments are 34% of TTM OCF.
text.zh: FY26 OCF $32.0B - 资本开支 $55.7B = FCF -$23.7B；TTM 缺口 -$28.7B；预付款占 TTM OCF 34%。

text.en: New OCI capacity must earn more than its cost of capital and turn FCF positive (~FY2030 in my model) before debt and lease commitments tighten.
text.zh: 新增的 OCI 算力必须赚到高于资本成本的回报，并在债务和租约压力加大前让 FCF 转正（我的模型中约在 FY2030）。

notes.en: Base = blend of guidance and consensus; consensus case $233.29. Beta 1.4; TV 74% of EV.
notes.zh: 基准 = 公司指引与一致预期的平均；一致预期情景 $233.29。Beta 1.4；终值占 EV 74%。

notes.en: Morningstar FV dated Oct 15, 2026 (Very High uncertainty). vs price: Nov 16 close.
notes.zh: Morningstar 估值日 2026年10月15日（不确定性 Very High）。较现价按 11月16日收盘。

text.en: FY12-26 OCF $242.4B less capex $110.5B left **$131.9B FCF**. Buybacks **$155.9B (118%)**; dividends **$46.5B (35%)**; acquisitions **$59.8B** (Cerner $27.7B). Buybacks stopped as the AI build began: **$0.1B** in FY26 vs $36.1B in FY19.

Diluted shares FY12 5,095M to FY26 2,914M, **down 43%** on debt-funded buybacks. The trend has reversed: ~**$19.9B of ATM equity** in Q1 FY27 lifted shares outstanding to **3.12B**, about 7% above the FY26 count.
text.zh: 稀释股数由 FY12 的 5,095M 降至 FY26 的 2,914M，**减少 43%**，主要靠举债回购。趋势已经反转：Q1 FY27 通过 ATM 增发约 **$199 亿**股票，流通股增至 **31.2 亿股**，比 FY26 多约 7%。

headline.en: Growth is real; the bill is capital.
headline.zh: 增长是真的，代价是资本。

body.en: Q1 FY27 revenue rose 29.6% to $19.35B and EBIT 57.3% to $6.73B, led by OCI (+121%). Capex rose 3.35x to $28.5B in the same quarter, so each new revenue dollar now costs more than a dollar of upfront spending.
body.zh: Q1 FY27 营收增长 29.6% 至 $19.35B，EBIT 增长 57.3% 至 $6.73B，主要靠 OCI（+121%）。同一季度资本开支增至 3.35 倍，达 $28.5B：每新增一美元收入，前期要先投入超过一美元。

headline.en: A software cash machine became a builder.
headline.zh: 软件现金机器变成了建设者。

body.en: Capex was 5.3% of revenue in FY17 and 82.6% in FY26. FCF went from +$11.8B (FY24) to -$0.4B (FY25) and -$23.7B (FY26). Past software cash flow cannot be extrapolated; depreciation alone rose from $3.9B to $7.6B in one year.
body.zh: 资本开支占营收由 FY17 的 5.3% 升至 FY26 的 82.6%。FCF 由 FY24 的 +$11.8B 变为 FY25 的 -$0.4B、FY26 的 -$23.7B。过去的软件现金流不能直接外推；仅折旧一年内就由 $3.9B 升至 $7.6B，未来几年折旧还会持续压低利润率。

body.en: Customer prepayments of $16.0B are 34% of TTM OCF. Without them, OCF covers 41% of capex instead of 62%. Real liquidity, but tied to future delivery: if a large customer slows its build or renegotiates, OCF falls just as capex peaks.
body.zh: 客户预付款 $16.0B，占 TTM OCF 34%。剔除后，OCF 对资本开支的覆盖由 62% 降至 41%。这是真实的流动性，但与未来交付义务绑定：若大客户放缓建设或重新谈判，OCF 会在资本开支见顶时同步下滑。

headline.zh: 杠杆和租约限制了灵活性。

body.en: Debt is $134.5B incl. finance leases; EBIT covers interest 4.5x. Another $288B of data-center leases has not yet started. S&P downgraded Oracle in July 2026. Buybacks have stopped and ATM equity is now a funding source, so per-share value depends on capital discipline.
body.zh: 含融资租赁的债务 $134.5B；EBIT 覆盖利息 4.5 倍。另有 $2,880 亿数据中心租约尚未起租。S&P 已于 2026年7月下调 Oracle 评级。回购已停止，ATM 增发成为资金来源，每股价值取决于资本纪律。

headline.zh: RPO 是可见度，不是现金。

body.en: $664B of RPO, ~13% in the next 12 months, depends on on-time capacity. Morningstar cut the moat to Narrow and flagged a possible $25B+ revenue delay on Project Jupiter. Track RPO conversion each quarter, not new bookings.
body.zh: $664B 的 RPO 中约 13% 在未来 12 个月确认，前提是算力按时交付。Morningstar 已把护城河下调为 Narrow，并提示 Project Jupiter 可能延迟 $250 亿以上收入。应逐季跟踪 RPO 转化为收入的速度，而不是新签合同额。

headline.en: The DCF needs capex to roll over.
headline.zh: DCF 需要资本开支见顶回落。

body.en: Base $243.09 (9.6% WACC, 3% g, beta 1.4) needs ~$373B revenue by FY36 at a 32% EBIT margin and capex falling to ~13.5% of sales; 74% of EV is terminal. At $119.09 that is +104%; bear $101.32 is -15%. Morningstar ($195) uses the same WACC and revenue path but peaks capex at $120B, not $84B, and keeps FCF negative until FY31; that capex path, not the discount rate, explains most of the $48 gap.
body.zh: 基准价值 $243.09（WACC 9.6%，g 3%，beta 1.4）要求 FY36 营收约 $3,730 亿、EBIT 利润率 32%，且资本开支降到营收约 13.5%；终值占 EV 74%。按 $119.09 计空间 +104%；悲观情景 $101.32，下跌 15%。Morningstar（$195）的 WACC 和营收路径与我相近，但资本开支峰值为 $1,200 亿（我的是 $840 亿），FCF 到 FY31 才转正；$48 的差距主要来自资本开支路径，而不是折现率。

en: FY12-26 from SEC 10-K XBRL (fiscal years end May 31); Q1 FY27 and TTM from the Aug 31, 2026 10-Q. Cash + ST FY17-26 from the analyst model (cash + marketable securities).
EBITDA* = operating income + depreciation + intangible amortisation. FCF = OCF - capex. Debt = notes payable incl. current portion (excl. leases). Net debt/EBITDA* from the analyst model.
ROIC* = op. income x (1-17%) / (equity + debt - cash), year-end. ROE* NM when equity < 8% of assets (buybacks shrank equity). Dividend/Sh.* = dividends paid / diluted shares.
Header: Nov 16, 2026 close $119.09, 3.12B shares; book value = Aug 31, 2026 equity $67.2B / 3.12B; TTM P/E; P/FCF NM (negative FCF). FY22-26 P/E, yields and Mkt cap* from StockAnalysis (FY-end).

DCF: Pythia model ORCL_DCF_Model_10Y, valuation date Nov 6, 2026 (price $116.10); WACC 9.6%, g 3.0%. Street avg target = 42-analyst average via StockAnalysis/S&P Global. Morningstar FV $195 (Oct 15, 2026).
Sources: Oracle FY2026 10-K, Q1 FY2027 10-Q; SEC EDGAR; StockAnalysis; Morningstar equity report (Nov 17, 2026) and notes (Mar-Oct 2026); S&P Global Ratings (Jul 10, 2026).
zh: FY12-26 数据取自 SEC 10-K XBRL（财年截至 5月31日）；Q1 FY27 与 TTM 取自 2026年8月31日 10-Q。FY17-26 现金及短投取自分析模型（现金 + 有价证券）。
EBITDA* = 营业利润 + 折旧 + 无形资产摊销。FCF = OCF - 资本开支。债务 = 应付票据（含一年内到期，不含租赁）。净债务/EBITDA* 取自分析模型。
ROIC* = 营业利润 ×（1-17%）/（权益 + 债务 - 现金），年末口径。ROE* 在权益低于资产 8% 时记为 NM（回购使权益缩小）。每股股息* = 已付股息 / 稀释股数。
首行：2026年11月16日收盘 $119.09，31.2 亿股；每股账面 = 2026年8月31日权益 $67.2B / 31.2 亿股；TTM P/E；P/FCF 为 NM（FCF 为负）。FY22-26 的 P/E、收益率与市值*取自 StockAnalysis（年末口径）。
DCF：Pythia 模型 ORCL_DCF_Model_10Y，估值日 2026年11月6日（股价 $116.10）；WACC 9.6%，g 3.0%。华尔街平均目标价为 42 位分析师平均（StockAnalysis / S&P Global）。Morningstar 合理价值 $195（2026年10月15日）。
来源：Oracle FY2026 10-K、Q1 FY2027 10-Q；SEC EDGAR；StockAnalysis；Morningstar 股票研究报告（2026年11月17日）及 3-10月 点评；S&P Global Ratings（2026年7月10日）。

summary.en: A software cash machine turned AI-infrastructure builder: OCI growth and a $664B backlog are real, but capex now exceeds operating cash flow, so the value depends on capex rolling over before debt and lease commitments bite.
summary.zh: 从软件现金机器转型为 AI 基础设施建设者：OCI 增长和 $6,640 亿未履约合同是真的，但资本开支已超过经营现金流，价值取决于资本开支能否在债务和租约压力加大前见顶回落。

business.en:
### Four revenue lines
- **Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI):** rents compute and GPU capacity, largely to AI customers; about 27% of FY26 revenue and growing fastest (+121% in Q1 FY27).
- **Cloud applications (SaaS):** Fusion ERP, NetSuite, health (Cerner); about 23%.
- **License support and licenses:** the database and middleware installed base; about 36%, flat but very profitable.
- **Hardware and services:** about 13%.

### The change
Oracle is spending most of its revenue on data centers (capex 82.6% of FY26 revenue) to deliver contracted AI capacity. Remaining performance obligations reached $664B at Aug 31, 2026.

### Key risks
Funding gap and leverage ($134.5B debt, $288B of uncommenced leases), customer concentration and prepayment timing, delivery delays, AI demand cycle, and the 2026 credit downgrade.
business.zh:
### 四条收入线
- **Oracle 云基础设施（OCI）：** 出租算力和 GPU，主要客户是 AI 公司；约占 FY26 营收 27%，增长最快（Q1 FY27 +121%）。
- **云应用（SaaS）：** Fusion ERP、NetSuite、医疗（Cerner）；约 23%。
- **许可证支持与许可证：** 数据库和中间件的存量客户；约 36%，持平但利润率很高。
- **硬件与服务：** 约 13%。

### 发生了什么变化
Oracle 把大部分营收投入数据中心（FY26 资本开支占营收 82.6%），以交付已签约的 AI 算力。截至 2026年8月31日，未履约合同（RPO）达 $6,640 亿。

### 关键风险
资金缺口与杠杆（债务 $1,345 亿、$2,880 亿未起租租约）、客户集中与预付款时点、交付延迟、AI 需求周期，以及 2026 年信用评级下调。

summary.en: Morningstar's fair value is **$195** (Oct 15, 2026); mine is **$243.09**, **+$48.09** higher. The two models agree on more than they differ: both use a **9.6% WACC**, both have revenue growing about **31% a year to FY31** (Morningstar $264B, mine $256B) and an operating margin near **28-29%** in FY31, and in both the terminal value is **74% of EV**. The gap is the **capex path**. Morningstar has capex peaking at **$120B in FY28** and free cash flow negative until FY31 (**-$111B** over FY27-31); my model peaks at **$84B** and turns positive in FY30 (**+$17B** over FY27-31). Lower capex also leaves a larger normalised cash flow for my terminal value. Partly offsetting: I divide by **3,193M shares** (after the ATM issuance) against Morningstar's 3,026M. The stock at **$119.09** sits below both.
summary.zh: Morningstar 的合理价值为 **$195**（2026年10月15日）；我的是 **$243.09**，高 **$48.09**。两个模型的共同点多于分歧：WACC 都是 **9.6%**；到 FY31 营收都以每年约 **31%** 增长（Morningstar $2,640 亿，我的 $2,560 亿）；FY31 营业利润率都在 **28-29%**；终值都占 EV 的 **74%**。差距在于 **资本开支路径**。Morningstar 的资本开支在 **FY28 达到 $1,200 亿峰值**，自由现金流到 FY31 才转正（FY27-31 合计 **-$1,110 亿**）；我的模型峰值为 **$840 亿**，FY30 转正（FY27-31 合计 **+$170 亿**）。资本开支更低，也让我的终值所依据的正常化现金流更大。部分抵消的是：我用 **31.93 亿股**（含 ATM 增发）计算，Morningstar 用 30.26 亿股。现价 **$119.09** 低于两者。
